title: Editor's note: Seeking Alpha is proud to welcome Wall Street
text:
Editor's note: Seeking Alpha is proud to welcome Wall Street Wizard as a new contributor. It's easy to become a Seeking Alpha contributor and earn money for your best investment ideas. Active contributors also get free access to the SA PRO archive. Click here to find out more » 
If you are a value investor like myself, you are probably having difficulty finding a good value in the market. The Dow has now achieved 11 record days , and counting, thus far in 2018. Considering there have been only 22 days of market-trading, this is insanity! Valuations are screaming upward, with the current S&P 500 Price-to-Earnings (P/E) Ratio now at 26.82, versus the long term average of 15. It's not easy finding value in this market. There is also very little sector rotation going on. With the tax cuts and pro-business environment, all industries in the market are seemingly at full steam ahead. In these conditions, I think even Benjamin Graham, the founder of value investing, would have pocketed his wallet.
However, if you are patient and separate the wheat from the chaff, I think a good value emerges occasionally. Typically, on the back of bad news. Over-exaggerated and shortsighted bad news though. Like shares of Apple ( AAPL ), declining due to embellished and exaggerated concerns/rumors over iPhone sales. Not bad news like General Electric ( GE ), where like the entire company is in limbo.
One stock has recently caught my eye. Flying high, this stock is Alaska Air Group ( ALK ).
